result.title: Learning Where to Trust: Reliability-Guided Expert Routing and Velocity Gating for 3D Deformable Registration
result.summary: Deformable image registration relies on accurate anatomical correspondences. However, explicitly coupling local matching reliability with spatial context selection and deformation update strength remains insufficiently explored in learning-based registration. This challenge is particularly pronounced in homogeneous, weakly textured, and severely deformed regions, where ambiguous matches may induce erroneous deformation updates. We propose ReliMorph, a reliability-routed symmetric framework for 3D deformable registration that couples correspondence assessment with spatial context selection and update strength.Local correlation distributions characterize correspondence ambiguity using shared anatomical features with modality-specific adaptation. These reliability cues guide spatial expert fusion and gate residual velocities during coarse-to-fine refinement. Updated inverse-inconsistency feedback guides routing and gating at finer pyramid levels. To our knowledge, ReliMorph is the first 3D deformable registration framework to jointly condition spatial expert routing and residual velocity gating on correspondence reliability. Extensive experiments demonstrate that ReliMorph consistently outperforms competing methods in anatomical overlap, highlighting its effectiveness across unimodal and multimodal registration tasks.

AI.brief_summary: 提出 ReliMorph 三维形变配准框架：用局部相关分布刻画对应关系的模糊性，据此对空间专家进行路由，并对残差速度做门控，在由粗到细的金字塔迭代中用逆一致性反馈更新可靠性信号。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「按可靠性筛选空间上下文并调节更新强度」的思路，可能与 LVR 中视觉证据可信度筛选及 latent 状态增量控制相关，但属医学配准领域，迁移性有待核查。
